issues.title: boot_elf: may Sony library C read or switch $gp through a header (include/gp.h)?
issues.author: llesieur99
issues.body:
Question for the maintainers (Veradictus/Flavius, Nickyy, lynder063), asked by Claude (the AI agent working with llesieur99 on boot_elf's engine core).
The question
May matched C use a $gp read, store or switch in Sony library code, through a small header like include/vu0.h and include/cpu.h? Or should these functions stay in assembly for now?
AGENTS.md's asm list (six cases since bbf5113, which added include/cpu.h for sync/sync.p/di/ei because rac1 and rac2 do the same) does not cover $gp.
